config.hkl_reason: Use standard-Pmmn (001), equivalent to the historical V2O5(010) layered cut, so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the slab normal; standard-Pmmn (010) is a different extinct direction.
HOPG is fiber-textured, so only the basal (00l) c-axis reflections are coherent; skip the automatic dominant-reflections search.
Layered h-BN is scanned with the c-axis normal; keep the basal (00l) family explicit to match the HOPG orientation model.
Pin the requested 1T-TiS2(003) symmetric-cut reflection so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the basal slab normal.
Pin the basal 1T-TiSe2(001) symmetric cut so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the c-axis-normal layered slab.
Pin the allowed black-phosphorus (020) symmetric cut so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the b-axis-normal layered slab.
Pin the basal 4H-SiC (0004) symmetric cut so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the c-axis-normal slab.
Pin the basal 6H-SiC (0006) symmetric cut so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the c-axis-normal slab.
Pin the allowed basal 1T-PtS2(001) symmetric cut parallel to the c-axis-normal cleavage surface; the existing relaxed structural model is retained.
Ambient Pbca PdS2 cleaves on (001), but odd 00l are extinct; pin the first allowed parallel (002) family and orient by the reciprocal surface normal.
Pin the allowed basal 1T-PdTe2(001) symmetric cut parallel to the c-axis-normal cleavage surface.
Pin the allowed basal trigonal beta-PtBi2(001) symmetric cut parallel to the c-axis-normal layered surface.
Pin the allowed basal 1T-PtTe2(001) symmetric cut parallel to the c-axis-normal cleavage surface.
Use the basal (001) symmetric cut of 1T-HfTe2 so the reciprocal vector remains parallel to the cleavable c-axis slab normal.
In the preserved Brown/COD 2310357 C2/m setting, distorted NbTe2 cleaves on (001); C centering permits 001 and the explicit basis gives a finite coupling.
Pin the allowed basal 1T-TiTe2(001) symmetric cut parallel to the c-axis-normal cleavage surface.
Pin the allowed basal ambient 1T-VSe2(001) symmetric cut parallel to the c-axis-normal cleavage surface.
In the preserved COD 1535594 C2/m setting, ambient distorted VTe2 cleaves on (001); C centering permits 001 and the idealized stoichiometric basis gives a finite coupling.

In the preserved COD 1562070 C2/m setting, layered GeP cleaves on (10-1); C centering extinguishes that plane, so pin the first allowed parallel (20-2) family and orient by its reciprocal surface normal.
In standard Pnma GeS the long a axis is the layer normal and (100) is the cleavage plane; odd h00 are extinct, so pin the first allowed parallel (200) family.
In the COD 4003515 standard-Pnma setting, GeSe cleaves on (100); odd h00 are extinct, so pin the first allowed parallel (200) family rather than importing 00l indices from alternate settings.

Layered beta-GeSe2 in the transformed standard P21/c:b1 setting cleaves on (001); the c-glide extinguishes odd 00l, so pin the first allowed parallel (002) family and orient by the reciprocal surface normal.

The license-clean MP mp-572758 distorted-1T ReS2 fallback carries a doubled c-axis, so odd 00l are near-extinct supercell harmonics (|S(001)|~=3); pin the first strong allowed parallel (002) family, the true single-layer basal reflection, and orient by the reciprocal (001) cleavage surface normal.
Pin the allowed basal distorted-1T ReSe2(001) harmonic from provisional COD 1539529 parallel to its reciprocal-normal cleavage surface.
Room-temperature 2H-TaS2 cleaves on (001), but P63/mmc stacking extinguishes odd 00l; pin the first allowed parallel (002) family.
Room-temperature 2H-TaSe2 cleaves on (001), but P63/mmc stacking extinguishes odd 00l; pin the first allowed parallel (002) family.
In the preserved ambient Brown/COD 2310358 C2/m setting, distorted TaTe2 cleaves on (001); C centering permits 001 and the explicit basis gives a finite coupling.

Idealized stoichiometric beta-FeTe uses the fully occupied PbO-type framework from experimental Fe1.095Te COD 4102703; the 9.5%-occupied interstitial Fe orbit is intentionally omitted because cxr-mc supports only fully occupied sites. Pin the finite basal (001) harmonic parallel to its cleavage surface.
Ambient Td-WTe2 in the preserved Brown/COD 2310355 Pnm21 axis setting cleaves on (001); odd 00l are extinct, so pin the first allowed parallel (002) family.
Room-temperature parent-phase ZrTe3 cleaves on (001); the explicit COD 1559502 P21/m basis gives a finite (001) coupling, so pin the first basal harmonic.
Room-temperature Cmcm ZrTe5 layers lie in the a-c plane and cleave on (010); C centering extinguishes (010), so pin the first allowed parallel (020) family.
